title: At the Pharmacy
summary: A customer asks for medicine and learns how often to take it.

lines.speaker: Cliente
lines.pt: Boa tarde. Estou com dor de cabeça desde cedo.
lines.en: Good afternoon. I have had a headache since early today.

lines.speaker: Cliente
lines.pt: Não, só preciso de um remédio simples.
lines.en: No, I just need a simple medicine.

lines.speaker: Farmacêutica
lines.pt: Este aqui é para dor e febre. Tome um comprimido a cada oito horas.
lines.en: This one is for pain and fever. Take one pill every eight hours.

lines.speaker: Cliente
lines.en: Do I need to take it with food?

lines.speaker: Farmacêutica
lines.pt: É melhor tomar depois de comer e beber bastante água.
lines.en: It is better to take it after eating and drink plenty of water.

lines.speaker: Cliente
lines.en: I understand. How much does it cost?

comprehension.question: What problem does the customer have?
How often should the customer take the pill?
When is it better to take the medicine?
